---
name: frontend-design
description: Create polished, distinctive, responsive web interfaces and dashboards with strong visual hierarchy.
---
# Frontend design
- Inspect current components, CSS, assets, and package.json before design changes.
- Define reusable color, typography, spacing, radius, shadow, and breakpoint tokens.
- Prioritize monitoring status, connection controls, live activity, leads, and secondary tools in the information hierarchy.
- Design desktop, tablet, and mobile intentionally; define mobile behavior for tables and dense data.
- Include loading, empty, error, offline, paused, reconnecting, and success states.
- Use semantic HTML, clear labels, keyboard focus, and adequate contrast in both themes.
- Avoid generic template visuals, excessive gradients/glass, decorative clutter, and arbitrary one-off styling.
- Reuse components and tokens; do not introduce a UI framework without checking the current stack.
